propositions: The batched-map transient recovery test fails when the batched resolver recovers from transient Git read errors but the one-shot per-event oracle returns None instead of an equivalent commit SHA.

Production resolve_event_commit deliberately returns None on any Git error, timeout, or exception and must not be modified; test-oracle defect lies in the fixture's failure to retry the per-event equivalence assertion.

A test-local bounded helper _fixture_per_event_commit must retry the per-event resolver up to five identical attempts and raise diagnostics (fsck, count-objects) on persistent failure, mirroring the batched fixture behavior.

All batched/per-event exact position-to-commit equivalence assertions in the test module must route through the bounded helper, including off-first-path and ledger-parity cases, preserving exact non-None SHA comparisons.
